title: Page 4
content_zh:
斐然被她那验货般的目光看了许久，正抬起玉手想摸上他的脸时，突然间整个人的模样骤然一变。运起内力的他，再也无丝毫醉态，脸也不红，气也不喘了，反倒是睁开了清明的双眼，躲开她欲碰上自己的手起身坐正，再事不关己般地看着手犹僵在空中的她。

情况骤然急转直下，被这份措手不及打得有些茫然的周菲，就这么错愣在当下，好半天都没法回过神来。

她愣愣地瞠大了美目，张口结舌，“这、这不可能……”

“不可能什么？”

她像见鬼似地两眼直盯着他的下身，“你怎会半点反应也无?!”不该是这样啊，在下了那么重的媚药后，就算是头牛也早该有反应了。

“在下该有什么反应？”斐然走下床榻，任由她犹两手撑按在床面上发怔。

当然是被药性迷惑了心智，身子求慾若渴，不碰女人便如众蚁囓心，如狼似虎般挺着慾望朝她扑过来的正常反应……经验丰富的周菲百思不解地想着。

可偏偏斐然他怎会什么反应也没有？当时她明明就亲眼看着他将那杯酒水给喝下腹的，难不成……

难不成……传言中斐然寡人有疾是真的？

瞪看着斐然一副神清气爽的模样，某种被蒙骗后的愤怒，似把闷火般地在她胸臆间燃烧了起来，她直摇着螓首，在满怀的不甘，与照妖镜般的现实两相对照之下，她抖颤着唇，似是不愿相信又不得不信地启口。

“不，这不可能……你可是然公子，你怎会是金玉其外的阉——”

斐然气息一窒，当下说翻脸就翻脸，掌腕一翻，一记掌风就朝她的脸扇了过去，直把她整个人给扇翻栽倒在床榻上。

“你、你怎么敢……”周菲难以置信地掩着刺痛的脸颊，好不容易才在床榻间挣扎起身。

“别太拿自个儿当回事了，以为你是女人我就会客气？”斐然冷冷瞥她一眼，“失礼了，怜香惜玉这四字，我斐然这辈子就从没学过。”

恼羞成怒的她一手直指着他，“我……我要告诉我爹，你竟敢如此对我……”

“爬床不成还有脸去向老父告状？你也够知廉耻了。”斐然若无其事地别开眼，朝客房外头拍了拍两掌。

早就候在外头的知书闻声立即开门入内，将时机捏得恰到好处，在斐然举步欲往外走时，正好拦下气红了一张脸，边放声尖叫边朝斐然扑过来的周菲。

“堵上她的嘴。”斐然懒得理会身后的烂摊子，只管吩咐知书后就往外头走，而等在门外的达礼随即迎了上来。

“三爷，都办妥了。”

他点点头，“该在城主的顶上安个什么罪名不必我教吧？”

“那自是当然。”坏事干多了，总是会愈来愈称手的。

斐然自始至终所在乎的只有一事，“人在哪？”好歹他也牺牲色相一回了，他可不打算在今晚空手而回。

达礼扬起一掌，“已带至客房，三爷这边请。”

第1章(2)

原本在席间与城主的门人们抱着美姬同乐，却在下一刻遭仆从打扮的人给掩住口鼻，然后绑来这间客房的任屿，此刻正一头雾水地蹲坐在客房的角落，怎么想也想不明白发生了何事，就在他想再开口问问门外看守着他的人时，斐然

“然公子？”任屿讶然地看着曾在今晚席间见过的城主贵宾。

“你认识杜衍仲？”斐然也不多废话，开口就直指重点。

他一怔，“是……”

“前阵子还同他喝过酒？”

“你怎么知——”任屿不解地开口想询问，下一刻，一只大掌已牢牢地按握在他的颈间，狠戾地一把将他给拖拉过来。

斐然难掩杀意地收紧了五指，“杜衍仲现下人在哪？”

当素有办事效率的知书料理完那位大小姐，也派人搞定以为事情已成、犹在大厅内饮酒庆贺的城主周漕雁时，斐然也已自任屿的口中得到了他所想要的消息。

“三爷？”知书拦下正匆忙想离开城主府的斐然。

“城主府的事，就由你俩留下善后。”满心迫切的斐然飞快地向他指示，“顺道捎封信告诉小皇帝一声，他最好是速速给南济城换个像样的新城主，不然下回我回原国时，他就得当心他那金贵的小屁股了。”

“是……”斐蓝如今都几岁了，还打他屁股板子？这也太不给他这个做皇帝的面子了。

“三爷，您要上哪？”替他牵来马匹的达礼，早已经习惯他动不动就抛下他俩，一人在外头擅自行事的作风了。

斐然接过他递来的缰绳，“我去会会我的那位老朋友。”

知书与达礼相互看了一眼，而后不约而同地叹口气。

“我俩就在南济城等着三爷。”这么多年来，斐然始终都念着的，也只有那一段抛不开的旧怨了。

“嗯。”他微微颔首，扯过缰绳后便任由座下的马儿纵蹄飞奔。

按着任屿所给的消息，斐然马不停蹄地一路往南济一处地理位置偏僻的乡下赶，不熟地况的他，在翻过几座地势险峻的山头后，便弃了行之不易的马匹，改以轻功继续赶路，只是，在人生地不熟的情况下，冒冒然只身前来寻仇的他，很快就感到后悔了。

一脚踏上这座不知名的山头后，就被阵阵白雾给拢困在其中，原地不知茫然打转了几回的斐然，再如何心急火燎的，也明白过于大意的自己这下子犯了什么错误了。

当他正想定下心来试着一解这来得诡异突兀的雾阵之时，陡地脚下一个踩空，就连半点呼救声也来不及发出，他便自山崖上一头栽了下去。

雾气弥漫的深谷底，终年不见阳光，一条水势湍急的小溪流经谷底，吟唱出悦耳的淙淙水音，可此刻在他人听来许是甚是悦耳的水音，在斐然的耳里听来，却犹如金鼓齐鸣万马奔腾。

斐然不知他究竟昏了多久，而坠至谷底并落入溪中的过程，他只记得他体内的内力莫名一空，哪怕他再如何运气也无法催动半分内力，于是在一路往下坠的过程中，他只能奋力攀抓着壁面上稀稀落落的藤蔓，想方设法地减缓下坠的速度，接着他便一头栽进浓密的白雾中，再坠至冰冷的溪水里。

巨大的冲击力道，当下令他昏了过去，他只知醒来后即身处在激流中，一手仅仅握住了一根卡在岩缝中的枯枝，而冰冽冻人的溪水早已麻木了他的身躯，以往蓄在他丹田中的内力全然枯竭，令丹田空空如也，也令他不知该如何从这困境中脱困而出。

紧咬着牙关在水中浮沉了约莫一个时辰后，他悲惨地发现，他用尽所有力气握住枯枝的手指已冻僵了，渐渐地，指尖再握不住枯枝，他的身子亦开始往水中沉去……

踩在草木上窸窣的足音，在斐然已经撑不住就将要放手时，宛如来自上苍的救赎，他费力睁开眼，扑面而来的晶莹水花模糊了他的视线，隐隐约约的，他看见在不远处的岸上出现了一道逐渐走近的灰色身影，他深深喘了喘，终于挤出了一丝力气向岸上喊道。

“救命……”

来者在听见他的沙哑呼唤后，蓦地止住了步伐，目光准确地落至他的身上，却在见着他后飞快地往后退了两步。

“等等，别走……”斐然见来者似要转身离开，他忙出声留人。

站在岸上的人影，虽是如他所愿没有再挪步了，可他也不知是被溪水冻得太过昏沉，还是被无处不在的水花给影响了知觉，他总觉得那道灰色的身影在刹那间似乎缩小了许多，可一晃眼，就又恢复了原状。
content_en:
Fei Ran was stared at by her inspecting eyes for a long time, and when he raised his jade hand to touch his face, his whole appearance suddenly changed.After mobilizing his inner strength, he was no longer drunk, his face was no longer red, and he was no longer panting. Instead, he opened his clear eyes, avoided her hand that was about to touch him, stood up and sat up straight, and looked at her with her hand frozen in the air as if it was nothing to him.

The situation suddenly took a turn for the worse. Zhou Fei, who was caught off guard and was a little dazed, was so stunned in the moment that she couldn't recover for a long time.

She widened her beautiful eyes in confusion and was speechless, "This, this is impossible..."

"Impossible what?"

She stared at his lower body as if she was seeing a ghost, "How come you didn't react at all?!" That shouldn't be the case. Even a cow should have reacted long ago after taking such a heavy dose of love potion.

"How should I react?" Feiran walked off the bed, leaving her with both hands on the bed in a daze.

Of course, the drug has confused the mind, and the body is thirsty. If he doesn't touch a woman, he will be like ants gnawing at his heart. It is a normal reaction to pounce on her with desire like a wolf and a tiger... Zhou Fei, who is experienced, thought in confusion.

But why did Fei Ran not react at all?At that time, she clearly watched him drink the glass of wine with her own eyes. Could it be...

Is it possible...that the rumor that Fei Ran is ill is true?

Staring at Fei Ran's refreshing appearance, some kind of anger after being deceived seemed to burn in her chest like a sultry fire. She kept shaking her head. In contrast to the unwillingness in her heart and the reality like a mirror, she trembled her lips and spoke as if she didn't want to believe it but had to believe it.

"No, this is impossible...you are a young master, how can you be a noble eunuch—"

Fei Ran's breath was suffocated, and he immediately turned his face. With a flip of his palm, he slapped her face with a gust of wind, causing her whole body to fall to the bed.

"How dare you..." Zhou Fei covered her stinging cheeks in disbelief, and finally struggled to get up from the bed.

"Don't take yourself too seriously. Do you think I'll be polite to you because you're a woman?" Feiran glanced at her coldly, "I'm sorry, I have never learned the words "love the fragrance and cherish the jade" in my life."

She became so angry that she pointed her hand at him, "I...I want to tell my father how dare you do this to me..."

"You can't climb the bed and you still have the nerve to complain to my father? You have enough sense of shame." Feiran looked away as if nothing had happened and clapped his hands twice towards the outside of the guest room.

Zhishu, who had been waiting outside for a long time, immediately opened the door and went in when he heard the sound, timing it just right. When Feiran was about to walk out, he happened to stop Zhou Fei, whose face turned red with anger and screamed at the same time as he rushed towards Feiran.

"Keep her mouth shut." Feiran didn't bother to pay attention to the mess behind him. He just ordered Zhishu and walked out. Da Li, who was waiting outside the door, immediately came up to him.

"Third Master, it's all done."

He nodded, "You don't need to tell me what crime should be placed on the city lord's head, right?"

"Of course." If you do too many bad things, you will always get better at it.

Fei Ran only cared about one thing from beginning to end, "Where is the person?" After all, he had sacrificed his appearance for once, and he didn't plan to return empty-handed tonight.

Da Li raised his hand and said, "You have been brought to the guest room. Third Master, please come over here."

Chapter 1(2)

Ren Yu, who was originally enjoying the banquet with the city lord's disciples holding Mei Ji in their arms, was covered up by servants in the next moment, and then kidnapped to the guest room. Ren Yu was squatting in the corner of the guest room in confusion, unable to figure out what was going on. Just when he wanted to ask the person guarding him outside the door, Fei Ran

"Master Ran?" Ren Yu looked at the distinguished guest of the city lord whom he had met at tonight's banquet in surprise.

"Do you know Du Yanzhong?" Feiran didn't waste any more nonsense and got straight to the point.

He was startled, "Yes..."

"Did you drink with him a while ago?"

"How did you know -" Ren Yu opened his mouth to ask in confusion, but the next moment, a big hand was firmly pressed on his neck, and he was dragged over fiercely.

Fei Ran couldn't hide his murderous intent and tightened his fingers, "Where is Du Yanzhong?"

When Zhishu, who was known for his efficiency, finished taking care of the young lady and sent someone to deal with the city lord Zhou Caoyan who was still drinking and celebrating in the hall, thinking that the matter was done, Feiran had already gotten the news he wanted from Ren Yu.

"Third Master?" Zhishu stopped Fei Ran who was about to leave the City Lord's Mansion in a hurry.

"It's up to you two to deal with the matter in the City Lord's Mansion." Fei Ran, full of urgency, quickly instructed him, "Send a letter along the way to tell the little emperor that he'd better replace Nanji City with a decent new City Lord as soon as possible, otherwise he will have to watch out for his precious little ass next time I return to the original country."

"Yes..." How old is Fei Lan now, and she still spanks him?This does not give him the dignity of being an emperor.

"Third Master, where are you going?" Da Li, who had fetched the horse for him, was already used to him leaving them alone and doing things alone outside.

Feiran took the reins from him and said, "I'm going to meet my old friend."

Zhishu and Da Li looked at each other, and then sighed in unison.

"We will wait for the Third Master in Nanji City." Over the years, the only thing Fei Ran has been thinking about is the old grudge that cannot be put aside.

"Yes." He nodded slightly, pulled the reins, and let the horse gallop away.

According to the information given by Ren Yu, Fei Ran drove non-stop to a remote countryside in Nanji. He was not familiar with the terrain. After climbing over several steep mountains, he abandoned the hard-traveled horses and continued on the road using light skills. However, he quickly regretted the risk of coming alone to seek revenge when he was not familiar with the place.

As soon as he set foot on this unknown mountain, he was trapped in the white mist. Fei Ran spun around in confusion several times. No matter how impatient he was, he understood what mistake he had made because of his carelessness.

Just when he was about to calm down and try to figure out the strange and sudden mist formation, he stepped on the steep ground and fell down the cliff before he could even make a cry for help.

At the bottom of the mist-filled deep valley, where there is no sunshine all year round, a fast-flowing stream flows through the valley bottom, singing a pleasant sound of gurgling water. But at this moment, what may sound like a pleasant sound to others, to Fei Ran's ears, is like the sound of golden drums and the sound of thousands of horses galloping.

Fei Ran didn't know how long he had been unconscious, but when he fell to the bottom of the valley and into the stream, he only remembered that the internal energy in his body was inexplicably empty. No matter how lucky he was, he could not activate even half of his internal energy. So during the fall, he could only cling to the sparse vines on the wall and try every means to slow down his fall. Then he fell headlong into the thick white mist, and then fell into the cold stream.

The huge impact made him faint immediately. When he woke up, he was in a torrent, holding only a dead branch stuck in a rock crevice with one hand. The freezing stream water had already numbed his body. The internal energy stored in his dantian was completely exhausted, leaving his dantian empty, and he didn't know how to get out of this predicament.

After clenching his teeth and floating in the water for about an hour, he tragically discovered that the fingers he used all his strength to hold on to the dead branches were frozen. Gradually, his fingertips could no longer hold the dead branches, and his body began to sink into the water...

The sound of footsteps on the grass and trees was like a salvation from God when Feiran could no longer hold on anymore and was about to let go. He struggled to open his eyes, and the crystal water splashing in his face blurred his vision. Faintly, he saw a gray figure gradually approaching on the shore not far away. He took a deep breath and finally squeezed out a little strength to shout to the shore.

"Help..."

After hearing his hoarse call, the visitor suddenly stopped walking, his eyes fell accurately on him, but after seeing him, he quickly took two steps back.

"Wait, don't leave..." Feiran saw that the visitor seemed to be about to turn around and leave, so he hurriedly said something to save people.

Although the figure standing on the shore did not move any further as he wished, he did not know whether it was due to the cold water in the stream or the ubiquitous water splash that affected his consciousness. He always felt that the gray figure seemed to shrink a lot in an instant, but in a blink of an eye, it returned to its original shape.
